sloka: कृत उद्वाहम् तु राजानम् ब्रह्मदत्तम् महीपतिः ।सदारम् प्रेषयामास स उपाध्याय गणम् तदा ॥१-३३-२५॥
transliteration: kṛta udvāham tu rājānam brahmadattam mahīpatiḥ ।sadāram preṣayāmāsa sa upādhyāya gaṇam tadā ॥1-33-25॥

translations.english: Then the king along with his queens performed the marriage of his daughters in the assembly of priests and sent them with Brahmadatta (to his kingdom).
